blocklist.title: Block words
blocklist.rules: Messages whose name, text, gift or other event details contain a block word are hidden or not read aloud. Matching ignores letter case and full-width forms. Chat history keeps every message; removing a word shows its messages again.
blocklist.global_help: Hidden from Chat, the web panel and the overlay, and not read aloud.
blocklist.tts_help: Not read aloud; still shown in Chat.
blocklist.controls: %d / %d · ↑ ↓ select · Enter adds or removes the selected word · Esc back
blocklist.duplicate: These words are already in the list
blocklist.too_long: Each block word can have at most %d characters
blocklist.too_many: Each list can hold at most %d words
